headword: {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}

definitions.explanation: the date by which a borrowed item must be returned

examples.japanese: {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧です。
examples.english: The return deadline is next Friday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The return deadline for the library book has passed.

examples.japanese: {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}らない→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{延滞料|えんたいりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful, as late fees will be charged if you don't meet the return deadline.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧ (return, giving back) + ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧ (deadline, time limit). Most commonly encountered in libraries, rental services, and equipment lending contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to meet the return deadline
- {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: for the return deadline to pass
- {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to extend the return deadline
- {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}{日|び}: return due date

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧: deadline — general term for any deadline
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧: deadline, time limit — the general concept
- {返却日|へんきゃくび}: return date — the specific date of return
- {貸出期間|かしだしきかん}: lending period — the duration for which something can be borrowed
